text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report responds to a request from Councillor Glenn De Baeremaeker to modify the days and times on the parking machines and related signage in the area of the new library on Brian Harrison Way beside the Scarborough Civic Centre so as to allow free parking on Saturdays in a manner consistent with the regulations along Borough Drive.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Amended the parking machine regulation in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, on the west side of Brian Harrison Drive, between a point 68 metres north of Borough Drive and a point 85 metres north of Borough Drive for a fee of $2.00 for 1 hour for a maximum parking period of 3 hours, to be in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. 2. Amended the parking machine regulation in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, on the west side of Brian Harrison Drive, between a point 10 metres north of Borough Drive and a point 50 metres north of Borough Drive for a fee of $2.00 for 1 hour for a maximum parking period of 3 hours, to be in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. 3.
